glossary.definition:
(1) "Abused child" has the same meaning as in section 2151.031 of the Revised Code, and "neglected child" has the same meaning as in section 2151.03 of the Revised Code.

(2) "Active military service" and "uniformed services" have the same meanings as in section 3109.04 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 3109.051 - Parenting time - companionship or visitation rights.

glossary.definition: (3) "Confidential law enforcement investigatory record" has the same meaning as in section 149.43 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 3109.051 - Parenting time - companionship or visitation rights.

glossary.definition: (4) "Parenting time order" means an order establishing the amount of time that a child spends with the parent who is not the residential parent or the amount of time that the child is to be physically located with a parent under a shared parenting order.
glossary.source_title: Section 3109.051 - Parenting time - companionship or visitation rights.
